experiment_manifest.framing: Industrial Gas Flare vs. Confirmed Wildland Biomass Fire Thermal Discrimination

experiment_d_satellite_ablation.finding: Adding satellite increases flaring probability on NOAA-20 purely due to class distribution imbalance (flaring is 54% NOAA-20, wildfire is 13% NOAA-20). Satellite acts as an artificial proxy and MUST NOT be used in operational inference.
